Behind me, four shoe boxes on the shelf. Each one has a card in front of it, in my handwriting, because I never trusted a label I didn't write myself. By the end of this video, those four cards are the only four kinds of shoe I'd tell you to buy after sixty-five. Not four brands. I don't do brands. Four kinds of shoe, and what to look at in each one so you don't get taken.

My father opened this store in nineteen fifty-one. One window. One bench. One bell on the door, and a brass one it was, because he said a customer should hear that they arrived. Now you know more than half my customers.
